chats.answer:
For programming, I'd prioritize typing comfort, layout, key feel, and programmability over gaming features.

My top pick is the Keychron K3 Max. It offers a good balance of compact size, mechanical typing feel, wireless connectivity, and customizable keys.

However, there are several excellent alternatives depending on whether you use macOS, prefer a split keyboard, or want the best possible typing experience.

Top 5 low-profile keyboards for programming (2026)

1. NuPhy Air75 V3 — Best overall typing experience

75% · Gasket mount · Wireless

$139.95

Excellent for long coding sessions, with a slim chassis, softer typing feel and dedicated arrow keys. RTINGS also names it its top low-profile pick. 
RTINGS.com

2. Keychron K3 Max — Best for customization

75% · QMK/VIA · Hot-swap option

$87.49

Best for developers who want custom layers, macros, remapped keys and reliable Mac/Windows support.

3. Lofree Flow 2 84 — Best premium typing feel

75% · Aluminum · Gasket mount

$159.00

Premium construction, smooth switches, sound dampening and VIA customization. Great if you type for hours every day.

4. Keychron K1 Max — Best for navigation keys

80% TKL · QMK/VIA · Wireless

$127.19

Better if you regularly use Home, End, Delete, Page Up and Page Down while navigating code.

5. Logitech MX Mechanical Mini — Best for office use

Compact · Quiet tactile option · Multi-device

$129.99

Easy to use, convenient device switching and understated styling. Less customizable than Keychron.

chats.answer:
For programming, I'd prioritize typing feel, layout, programmability, and comfort over gaming features.

My top picks are the NuPhy Air75 V2, Keychron K3 Max, and Lofree Flow84. They serve slightly different needs:

NuPhy Air75 V2: Best overall balance for coding.

Keychron K3 Max: Best for customization and value.

Lofree Flow84: Best for a premium typing experience.

I'd generally recommend a 75% layout for programming. You keep the arrow keys, function row, and navigation keys without taking up as much desk space as a full-size keyboard.

Best models to buy in 2026
